$comment: Production defaults from COMPOSITION.md. Starting points, not genre definitions: establish tempo and structure from the references first. Sections are 1-based bars; energy 0..1 drives which roles play (see composition partsForEnergy).

house.defining_idea: hook, riff, vocal or bass identity

deep_house.priority: Warm harmony, subtle movement, restrained transitions
deep_house.voicing: sevenths and ninths; parallel or voice-led; keep chords out of the sub register

melodic_techno.priority: Hypnotic bass, evolving lead, long builds
melodic_techno.defining_idea: lead motif or arp with timbral evolution

techno.voicing: pedal tones and drones; change upper intervals over a fixed bass

groove.anchor: Keep the kick quantised until there is a musical reason not to.
groove.order: velocity variation before timing changes; bass only if it improves the drum/bass pocket

arrangement_rules.note: Change is not the same as adding a layer: subtract, filter, modulate. Reserve the fullest state for the real peaks.

palettes.natural_minor: Aeolian: i-VI-III-VII cyclic, i-VII-VI-VII hypnotic, i-iv-VII-III journey
palettes.dorian: Minor centre with a bright major sixth: i-IV exposes the colour; i-ii-IV-i moves gently
palettes.harmonic_minor: Raised seventh for a darker leading tone
palettes.phrygian: Flat second for a dark, tense techno colour
